breville-smart-oven-air-fryer-pro-bov900: Even cooking that stands in for an oven; greasy cleanup.
breville-smart-oven-pro-bov845: Quick, even heat that replaces the oven; convection fans fail.
breville-sous-chef-16-pro-bfp800: Sturdy, powerful and still slicing well after years.
breville-super-q-bbl920: Quieter than a Vitamix with velvety smoothies; the lid is tight.
cosori-dual-blaze-6-8-qt: Two elements cook evenly without shaking; nonstick wears for some.
cosori-pro-le-5-qt: Compact, quick and easy to clean; small for bigger batches.
cosori-turboblaze-6-qt: Quick, quiet and easy to clean; runs hot, so trim cook times.
instant-pot-duo: No-fuss cooker that lasts a decade; sealing rings hold smells.
instant-pot-duo-crisp: Pressure cooker and air fryer in one; the fryer is small and fiddly.
instant-pot-pro: Handled pot and better sauté; many units get stuck in preheat.
instant-pot-pro-crisp: Crisps chicken for one or two; small, with uneven heat.
instant-vortex-6-qt: Simple and reliable for years; a burnt plastic smell is the gripe.
instant-vortex-plus-6-qt: Crisps fries and burgers well; smells of plastic at first.
kitchenaid-heavy-duty-5-2-l-bowl-lift-st: Stronger than a tilt-head on dough; some new units died.
ninja-air-fryer-af101: Simple, sturdy value for one or two; grease builds up inside.
ninja-crispi-fn101: Dishwasher-safe glass bowls double as storage; weaker air frying.
ninja-crispi-pro-as101: Glass lets you watch food and replaced many ovens; some undercooking.
ninja-flip-toaster-oven-sp151: Flips out of the way and does a lot; the elements are hard to clean.
ninja-foodi-digital-air-fry-oven-sp101: Heats fast and flips up to save space; grease bakes onto it.
ninja-foodi-flexbasket-dz071: One big drawer or two zones that finish together; quick to wash.
ninja-foodi-max-dual-zone-smart-cook-af4: Dual baskets, sync finish and a probe; a couple failed early.
philips-airfryer-4000-series-stacked-dua: Compact stacked baskets with a light and windows to check food.
philips-airfryer-5000-series-dual-basket: Steam keeps vegetables, chicken and fries moist.
typhur-dome: Easy-clean ceramic basket and quiet; food near the top can burn.
typhur-dome-2: Cooks lots without flipping; big footprint, shallow for tall food.
vitamix-5200: Tough, simple blender that lasts a decade; loud.
vitamix-5300: Long-lasting workhorse, often refurbished; loud, bad at small batches.
vitamix-alta-pro: Handy presets and self-clean; loud, with a burning smell for some.
vitamix-ascent-a2500: Easy presets and solid feel; small batches stall or cavitate.
vitamix-ascent-a3500: Powerful with easy presets; container detection and errors annoy.
vitamix-ascent-x2: A physical knob alongside the presets; container detection irks a few.
vitamix-explorian-e310: Good value and fine for small batches; loud, weaker on thick blends.
vitamix-professional-series-750: Powerful and runs for a decade; some switches or motors failed.
vitamix-venturist-v1200: Good value with a timer and presets; containers go unrecognised.
